class.name: AudioBusLayout
class.brief_description: Stores information about the audio buses.
class.description: Stores position, muting, solo, bypass, effects, effect position, volume, and the connections between buses.

method.name: generate_from_server_bus_layout
method.description: Clears and generates the layout based on the current buses of the [AudioServer].

method.name: set_server_bus_layout
method.description: Applies the layout to the [AudioServer] buses.
